title: Bibliography (v0)
description: Project-wide list of source references. Shipped as bibliography.json at the bundle root. Translated titles (when applicable) appear in locale files keyed by 'bibliography.<ref_key>.title'.

ref_key.description: Short stable citation key, author-chosen. Example: 'B1', 'A12', 'W3'. First letter conventionally aligns with category (B=Book, A=Article, W=Web, I=Interview) but not enforced.

title.description: Original-language title. Translations live in locale files under 'bibliography.<ref_key>.title'.

publisher.description: Publisher and place when applicable (e.g. 'Harper Perennial (London)').

year.description: Publication year. String is permitted for ranges or approximations ('1880-90', 'c.1900').

linked_stops.description: Stop slugs this source informs. Drives 'Sources' display per stop in the app.

linked_scenes.description: Scene IDs this source informs (when more specific than stop-level).
